By virtue of the present petition under Section 528 of the Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita,
2023, the petitioners seek quashing of FIR No.585/2025 dated 28.08.2025 registered at PS: New Usmanpur under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) and all proceedings emanating therefrom since the petitioner no.1 and respondent no.2 have since resolved all their disputes and gotten married to each other out of their own free will and love and affection on 19.12.2025 under Section 13 of the Special Marriage Act, 1954.
The present petition is also accompanied by the Marriage Certificate thereto, as well as the respective affidavits and proofs of identity of the parties.
2. Issue notice.

sentences.text:
Though this Court is cognisant that the aforesaid FIR is serious in nature with grave allegations,
however, since the petitioner no.1 and the respondent no.2 have voluntarily entered into a marital bond, which is also supported by valid documentation, and are now living together amicably since then.

Thus, following the law laid down by the Hon'ble Supreme Court in Jitendra Raghuvanshi &
Ors. vs. Babita Raguvanshi & Anr. (2013) 4 SCC 58, Gian Singh vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2012) 10 SCC 303 and Narinder Singh & Ors. vs. State of Punjab & Anr. (2014) 6 SCC 466, since there is nothing left to corroborate and prove the case of the prosecution, continuation of the aforesaid FIR against the petitioners will be an exercise in futility.
